criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: The Purdue campus GIS feature identifies OBJECTID 615 as Stewart Center. Its transformed footprint has about 10197 m² area. The model's structural wall envelope covers 99.6% of that polygon, but envelope IoU is 0.814: the model is a broad rectangle where the GIS outline has substantial recesses and stepped edges.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Manifest uses a local-coordinate asset and places its origin at [91.05, -253.375] m. Fresh-open probe shows the asset root at identity transform and local origin. The structural envelope and GIS polygon bounds agree closely on the west, north, and south extents; the model extends about 4 m farther east. Orientation is consistent with the campus map overlay. The master placement marker was not reopened in this independent asset grade.
criteria.status: mostly verified; master link not checked

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue archival material supports three floors in the central part of the complex. The model probe reports overall height 22.5 m and structural walls to 16.5 m, with a flat roof and three block-like rooftop forms. No authoritative elevation or roof plan was found to verify those heights or rooftop shapes, and the source notes that Stewart Center incorporates the former library and reconstructed Fowler Hall, which are not legible as distinct volumes here.
criteria.status: floor count source-supported; height and roof unverified

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Fresh Blender renders show red-brown wall material, repeated window/grid strips, horizontal bands, and a simple entry treatment. The facade reads as a generic rectangular box. Available Purdue imagery shows a more distinctive columned/stone-framed entrance and broad stair; the official archives describe the incorporated library/Fowler Hall composition and a mural above the HSSE library entrance. These distinctive features are not represented clearly in the asset.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh reopen confirms collection Asset_stewart_center in scene Building_stewart_center, with 1362 objects, a zeroed root, and 0 missing external image paths / 0 materialless meshes. The asset is self-contained with respect to image textures. Evidence is incomplete: no dimensioned elevation/roof evidence or pre-existing source record was found for this building, and the master link was not checked.

findings: Trace the structural wall geometry to the stepped GIS footprint, including the pronounced recesses and east-side projections; the current wall envelope is oversized and too rectangular.
Separate major building volumes where the floor plans and archival history support the former library and reconstructed Fowler Hall; avoid representing the entire complex as one uniform block.
Improve and source-check the principal columned/stone-framed entrance and broad stair, plus the library entrance and mural location; add additional facade rhythm from current oblique photographs.
Find authoritative elevations, roof plans, or measured height data before treating the 16.5 m wall top and 22.5 m overall height as verified; label them estimates until sourced.

Reopen the master and verify the single collection instance against the manifest origin/orientation, and add a building-specific evidence record with source dates, CRS, measurement steps, previews, and limitations.
